c2.evidence: Concrete per-referral payout: the referrer is paid $25 to their checking or savings account when the referred friend opens any new personal or commercial checking, savings, or certificate of deposit and the new account remains open at least 30 days.

c3.evidence: Mechanism: complete the Refer-a-Friend coupon and have the referred friend present it when opening the new account.

c4.evidence: Timing: within 60 days of the referred friend's account opening.

eligibility: Tennessee State Bank customers referring friends who open a new personal or commercial checking, savings, or CD.
notes: Tennessee State Bank (tnstatebank.com, Tennessee). The official coupon is dated August 2018 — verify program is still current before final acceptance.
payout_quote: You will be paid $25.00 to your personal or commercial checking or savings account as a bonus when you refer a friend that opens any new personal or commercial checking, savings or certificate of deposit ("new account") and the new account remains open for at least 30 days. ... Tennessee State Bank customers can earn up to $250 annually with this program.

s1.note: No upfront fee charged to the referrer.

s2.note: Referral is free; no cost to refer.

s3.note: Tax treatment not disclosed on the observed snippet.

s4.note: Annual cap: $250 per year per customer.

s5.note: Coupon live on the institution's official domain but dated August 2018 — currency uncertain.

steps: Complete the Tennessee State Bank Refer-a-Friend coupon.
